task: Build transparent geospatial LCOH model for African green hydrogen to Europe via ammonia by 2030
method_commitments: Use geospatial hexagon dataset with PV/wind potentials and infrastructure distances
Compute levelized cost of hydrogen (LCOH) production per site
Add downstream costs: ammonia synthesis, shipping, reconversion (cracking)
Compare to European domestic production benchmark computed with identical model
Evaluate multiple financing/policy scenarios via WACC (5%, 8%, 12%)
Identify least-cost locations and quantify competitiveness
